summary: Week 3 was the thinnest yet — 10 messages across three active days (8/15, 8/17, 8/19), then total silence on 8/20 and 8/21. The single biggest problem: the Aug 17 drop (3some Nico) from the pinned 8/3 schedule passed with zero mention in the chat by anyone. The two previous drops (Aug 10, Aug 12) each got a same-day check-in from Ollie; this one got nothing, so there is no in-chat evidence it shipped on the client's most important priority. Second problem: Alanna's last message of the week — 'Forgot to say I’m on live on my vip page so maybe stop chatting' at 11:43pm on 8/19 — is a live operational instruction to the chat team and nobody replied to it, ever. The account has been dead since. On the plus side Stephski hit her promised invoicing date exactly, sending the first invoice (period Aug 4-14) on 8/15 with banking and Zelle details; Michelle broke 14 days of promo silence on 8/17 with a reels content request and Drive folder; Mayson's custom domain (alannasworld.vip) landed 8/14 and Alanna thanked him on 8/15. But no payment confirmation has appeared in six days, and the long-aging onboarding items — IG impersonator takedown, chatter FAQ form, Mica's kickoff call — are now all 18 days old with not one word spoken about any of them. Derrek's promised weekly leak report is 9 days past the promise and has never been delivered.

health.rationale: Down 8 from 80. Three concrete regressions this week: (1) the Aug 17 pinned scene drop — her #1 stated priority — passed with no confirmation, coordination or mention from anyone, breaking the pattern set on Aug 10 and Aug 12; (2) her 8/19 'stop chatting, I'm live' instruction was never acknowledged by the chat team; (3) the chat has been completely dead since 8/19 and she is the one who went quiet after being ignored. Partially offset by Stephski delivering the first invoice exactly on the promised 8/15 date and Michelle finally producing promo work. But the first invoice is now 6 days out with no payment or acknowledgement in chat, and the 18-day-old onboarding items (IG takedown, FAQ form, Mica's kickoff call) went another full week untouched. This is the week the quiet aging started turning into visible neglect.
